title: Read
body:
Syntax: read <scroll>  (alias: study)

An inscribed jutsu scroll can teach ordinary Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu or Bukijutsu to a character of a different primary class. For example, a Taijutsu user may learn Narakumi by reading its Genjutsu scroll. It does not change your class or grant that class's automatic level-up jutsu. Bloodline, clan, village, gate, and special class-passive abilities cannot cross classes this way. Chakra nature, item, and other casting requirements still apply. A successfully read scroll is consumed; failed, blank and already-known scrolls are preserved. Scroll-learned jutsu do not need first teacher practice.
